articles.title: The Dark Brotherhood Quests - The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The guild known as The Dark Brotherhood is a secret society of assassins. You do not find them; they find you. If you're wondering how to begin your quest
articles.body:
The guild known as The Dark Brotherhood is a secret society of assassins. You do not find them; they find you. If you're wondering how to begin your quest and join this Skyrim faction, our guide will tell you everything you need to know.

To start the Dark Brotherhood quest line and join this faction, you must complete the Innocence Lost side quest. The easiest and quickest way to do this is to talk to Aventus Aretino in Windhelm and accept his first quest. You'll find him inside the Aretino Residence to the northeast of the Candlehearth Hall inn in the center of Windhelm.

He'll ask you to assassinate 'Grelod the Kind' in Riften's Honorhall Orphanage.

After completing the first quest, Innocence Lost, you will have to wait 24 hours before the Dark Brotherhood contacts you again. Sleep in a bed and the Brotherhood will abduct you and take you to a strange shack, with three hostages and a Dark Brotherhood assassin named Astrid. This starts the With Friends Like These... quest, where all you need to do is kill one of the hostages and you're in.

articles.body:
The Companions are a joinable guild in Skyrim that is similar to the Fighters Guilds in previous Elder Scrolls installments. The Companions follow the path of Ysgramor, who led 500 companions into Skyrim, being the first humans to settle in the Nord land. Aside from being able to train the player in warrior-relevant skills, the Companions' leadership has secrets that are revealed only to a member of their Circle.

You can use the links below to jump between sections:

The Companions is by far the easiest guild to join, and can be done within the first few hours of your playthrough. To start The Companions story, simply go to Jorrvaskr, the hall in the northeast of Whiterun , reached by turning right at the large tree in this city.

Inside, speak to Kodlak Whitemane, who will give you the Take Up Arms quest that introduces you to the guild's top dogs, Vilkas, Aela, and Farkas.

There are 18 Companions quests , six of which are main missions (starting with Take Up Arms and finishing with Glory of the Dead) and the rest are actually endlessly repeatable radiant quests:

For joining and complete The Companions' storyline, you can earn the following:

Access to master and expert trainers: Aela (Archery), Njada (Block), Farkas (Heavy Armor), Athis (One-Handed), Vilkas (Two-Handed), and Eorlund Gray-Mane (Smithing)

The Shield of Ysgramor, which grants Resist Magic and Fortify Health.

Wuuthrad, a two-handed battle axe which deals bonus damage to Elves and Falmer.

Access to the Skyforge, required to get Skyforge Steel weapons and armor.

An autonomous secret society comprised of skilled assassins, Skyrim's Dark Brotherhood is a shadow of its former self. They no longer follow the traditions of old and instead carve out their own existence by accepting kill contracts. They encourage the use of discretion when offing their targets.

You'll find him inside the Aretino Residence to the northeast of the Candlehearth Hall inn in the center of Windhelm.

He'll ask you to assassinate 'Grelod the Kind' in Riften's Honorhall Orphanage.

Rewards for Joining the Dark Brotherhood

For joining and completing the Dark Brotherhood storyline, you can earn the following:

Access to Babette and Nazir, master trainers for Alchemy and Light Armor respectively.

One of the three words for the Marked for Death shout.

The Shrouded Armor (and the Ancient Shrouded Armor), which provides poison resistance.

The Blade of Woe, a high damage dagger that absorbs health.

The Windshear unique one-handed sword that can stagger enemies.

Summon Spectral Assassin power, which summons the ghost of a legendary assassin.

Shadowmere, a unique horse with the best health and stamina.

articles.title: A Crucial Investigation Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: A Crucial Investigation is a side quest in Enshrouded that’ll send you to Glennwood’s End far to the northwest. There, you’ll investigate
articles.body:
A Crucial Investigation is a side quest in Enshrouded that’ll send you to Glennwood’s End far to the northwest. There, you’ll investigate something sinister that’s taken over the old town. This side quest walkthrough will show you how to get there quickly and what to do once you’re there.

You begin A Crucial Investigation after picking up the first Lore page in the Royal Investigation set called "By Royal Decree".

You can find that Lore page in a building at the top of the Imperial Gardens region. It’s laying on a table there for you to pick up.

Glennwood’s End is a small town to the northwest that was recently beset by Scavengers. It’s northwest of the Revelwood Ancient Spire, and that’s where you’ll start your journey to reach it.

Fast Travel to the Revelwood Ancient Spire and glide as far as you can to the northwest. There are a few cliffs you can aim for to land on and continue your glide on the other side.

Once you reach Glennwood’s End, you’ll find it overrun with scavengers. They aren’t particularly tightly packed or challenging, but don’t let them overwhelm you. Clear each small plaza one at a time until you reach the north side of the town.

The building you’re looking for is the tallest one at the north side by the cliffs. It has several barricades spread out around it and a torch over the front door.

Inside, you’ll find the Scavenger Matron and a few of her cronies. You’ll notice she’s a Gorger type, meaning she spews a sickly venom that deals significant damage if you stand in it. Whenever possible stay to her sides or behind her when attacking. If she points in your direction, dodge roll to either side to avoid her attacks.

When the Matron is defeated, loot her corpse to collect Legendary Runes, a Scavenger Matron Helmet, and some randomized loot.

Then, open the chest in the back of the room to collect Gold Coins , Sword Of the Serpent , and a Marksman’s Hood .

articles.summary: Mixed Stones is a quick side quest in Enshrouded that you can start and finish without taking more than a hundred steps. It unlocks a new building material for
articles.body:
Mixed Stones is a quick side quest in Enshrouded that you can start and finish without taking more than a hundred steps. It unlocks a new building material for you, so it’s well worth the quick detour to get it done. This side quest walkthrough will show you where to start and end the quest so you can start working with a new stone building material.

You start the Mixed Stones side quest by reading a Lore page titled “Where’s the Material?”

The Lore page in question is on table on a bridge leading to Lupa’s Lair. You’ll likely notice it while completing In Need of a Tanning Station.

To complete Mixed Stones, head further down the bridge and look for the hole on the north side. Drop down and use your Grappling Hook to rappel up to the ledge beneath.

Loot the treasure chest you find there to collect Regular Stone Blocks and complete the quest, earning you 75 XP in the process.

articles.title: Robert Gibson Needs Help Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Robert Gibson Needs Help is a side quest in Enshrouded that sends you after a survivor's fiancée in faraway East Lapis. She left just before the
articles.body:
Robert Gibson Needs Help is a side quest in Enshrouded that sends you after a survivor's fiancée in faraway East Lapis. She left just before the tragedy that befell her partner and now you have the wholesome opportunity to reunite them. This side quest walkthrough will take you through each step so you can bring these two back together.

To begin Robert Gibson Needs Help, you must first collect the soul of Robert Gibson in Lupa’s Lair. You’ll likely head there during In Need of a Tanning Station . You’ll find his skeleton in the secret area beneath the boss room. After you summon Robert Gibson and offer him sufficient shelter, he’ll start you on this quest to find his fiancée, Kaori.

How to Complete Robert Gibson Needs Help

The first step in this quest sends you to Kaori’s last known location, East Lapis, far to the northeast in the Kindlewastes. It’s a long walk, but you can get there fairly quickly if you take the right route. Start at the Kindlewastes Ancient Spire, glide northeast to the cliffs on your side of the Shrouded area. From there, glide north to the caves south of the marker.

You’ll find a passage there that will corkscrew up the mountain and spit you out on a road that’ll lead right to East Lapis.

Once you enter the ruined town, follow the marker to a large building on the east side beyond the broken bridge.

Inside, up the stairs, you’ll find a Lore page on a table. Read it to learn Kaori’s whereabouts: an office on the outskirts of town to the west.

Make your way across town to find a ruined two-story building with a long balcony on the upper floor. Head in and continue up the stairs to the room by the balcony.

You’ll find the skeleton of Kaori Conway there, finishing the quest and unlocking a new Villager to add to your settlement along with 150 XP.

articles.title: Pit Fights Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Pit Fights is a main quest in Enshrouded that earns you another Villager for your settlement. Turns out, a rough of tumble mercenary died in Surat’s
articles.body:
Pit Fights is a main quest in Enshrouded that earns you another Villager for your settlement. Turns out, a rough of tumble mercenary died in Surat’s Rest, and you might be able to recruit them. This walkthrough will show you how to start and end this brief quest while you’re at Surat’s Rest.

You start Pit Fights not far from where you finish it, in Surat’s Rest, the Scavenger stronghold at the southern center of the map. Because it’s so isolated, you’ll have to approach from the north. It helps to have a Flame Shrine at the top of the Pillars of Creation; you can glide all the way to your destination from there.

While you’re in Surat’s Rest, head to the square arena on the south side and go all the way up to the balcony on the east side. You’ll find a Lore Page resting on a bench titled “A Fearless Woman.” It tells of the mercenary you’re looking for and begins the Pit Fights quest.

You’ll find the mercenary’s skeleton not far from where you begin the Pit Fights quest. It’s on a stone ledge jutting out from the south of the Surat’s Rest cliffs. Head to the walkway on the south side of the stronghold and look down, you’ll see it below you.

Collect the mercenary’s soul and open the gold treasure chest nearby while you’re there. Then, head back to camp to summon her and complete the quest, earning you a new Villager and 125 XP.

articles.title: Tracing the Footsteps Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Tracing the Footsteps is a main quest in Enshrouded given to you by the Blacksmith’s Assistant. It sends you after a hunting party who braved the wilds
articles.body:
Tracing the Footsteps is a main quest in Enshrouded given to you by the Blacksmith’s Assistant. It sends you after a hunting party who braved the wilds between the Kindlewastes and the Nomad Highlands. This walkthrough will show you how to retrace their steps to bring home the soul of one of these unfortunate adventurers.

You can start the Tracing the Footsteps quest after saving Rochelle Anders during The Blacksmith’s Family . At that point, speak to her about “Hunting Party” and she’ll send you on the first objective.

To complete Tracing the Footsteps, you must first find the Hunting Party’s Camp. It’s at the base of a mountain that divides the Nomad Highlands from the Kindlewastes. The easiest way to get there is actually to start at the Nomad Highlands Ancient Spire and glide east. There’s a zigzagging path on the Nomad Highlands side of this mountain that’ll run you past a Flame Sanctum and, eventually, on a ledge directly over the Hunting Party Camp.

When you reach the Hunting Party Camp, you’ll see a large tent near the front. Side step the trap at the entrance and look inside for a Lore page titled “This Desert Contains Horrors.” It tells of a vulture nest to the north, where Galen ended up.

To reach the vulture nest, you’ll need to do a bit of mountain scaling. There should be enough ledges along the cliffs to the north to get you where you need to go, but don’t forget that you can always make ledges yourself with a Pickaxe.

When you reach the vulture nest, look to the nest at the highest point among them to find the familiar orange glow of a collectible soul. You’ll have to defeat the Vulture guarding it. Use a bow or other ranged weapon to get in a few hits from a distance, and you can bring it down with a melee weapon when it comes in to strike.

articles.title: Ramone's Writing Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Ramone's Writing is a main quest in Enshrouded that has you looking for a reporter who’d been hiding out in Pikemead’s Reach when the Shroud
articles.body:
Ramone's Writing is a main quest in Enshrouded that has you looking for a reporter who’d been hiding out in Pikemead’s Reach when the Shroud came. He was escaping persecution for attempting to hold the authorities accountable. This walkthrough will show you how to find him and bring him back to life so he can vindicate himself.

To start the Ramone's Writing quest, you must find a Lore page in Pikemead’s Reach titled “A Small Thank You.” You can find it in a ruined home near the east entrance to Pikemead’s Reach . It’s on the ground floor, and reading it also begins the Dark Rites quest.

To complete Ramone's Writing, you just need to find Ramone himself, and he just so happens to be directly under the Lore page you read to begin this quest. Head down to the basement below the house where you read “A Small Thank You” and look for the bookshelf against one of the walls.

Interact with the bookshelf to slide it open and reveal the skeleton of Ramone. Collect his soul and set him up in your settlement to complete the quest, earning you 125 XP and a new Villager for your Settlement.

articles.title: Enveloping Blood Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Enveloping Blood is a side quest in Enshrouded that tasks you with crafting and using a Drak Soulward Flask. These powerful potions will help you even the odds
articles.body:
Enveloping Blood is a side quest in Enshrouded that tasks you with crafting and using a Drak Soulward Flask. These powerful potions will help you even the odds against the Veilwater Basin denizens. This side quest walkthrough will show you how to craft your first one and put it to use to retake the wilderness.

To start Enveloping Blood, you must first enter the Veilwater Basin and complete Emerald Shores And Sanguine Seas to unlock the Fisher. Then, you must complete Obtaining a Mill for the Alchemist. At that point, the Hunter will have a new dialogue option: “Spill the Same Blood,” which starts you off on this quest.

To complete Enveloping Blood, you need to craft and drink a Drak Soulward Flask; which increases your damage against Drak enemies by 10% for 45 minutes, and enables you to read the Drak tablets you'll find scattered around Veilwater Basin. That’s easier said than done, since the ingredients are all hard-won trophies from Drak enemies, and it takes several of them to make a single flask:

There are no easy tricks for collecting these resources; you just have to go Drak hunting. Thankfully, the Drak are easy to find, roaming almost every ruined settlement and outpost throughout Veilwater Basin, and the roads that run between them. If you’re looking for a great place to do some Drak hunting, start with Orville, which also features a farm where you’ll find many of the region’s best ingredients like Ginger and Rice.

Once you’ve collected all the requisite ingredients, bring them to the Alchemist to brew them into a Drak Soulward Flask. Then, at any point after, drink the flask to complete the quest and earn 200 XP for finishing the quest. A good time to use this flask would be during the Fisher’s Vengeance quest you might also have in your quest log at this point.

articles.title: Finding Gold Coins Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Finding Gold Coins is a side quest in Enshrouded given by the Carpenter. He sends you into a Drak Temple in an effort to find valuable Gold Coins you can use
articles.body:
Finding Gold Coins is a side quest in Enshrouded given by the Carpenter. He sends you into a Drak Temple in an effort to find valuable Gold Coins you can use in construction. This side quest walkthrough will show you how to start the quest and how to infiltrate the lair of some gold-hoarding Drak.

For tips on how to have the best experience in Enshrouded, check out the following pages:

To start the Finding Gold Coins quest, you must first rescue the Fisher during Emerald Shores And Sanguine Seas. Afterward, you can speak to the Carpenter about a “Perfectly Sound Business Proposal” to begin this quest.

To complete Finding Gold Coins, you must head to a Drak’Dal Temple that’s southeast of the Veilwater Basin Ancient Spire . It’s close enough that you should be able to get there with one glide as long as you maneuver around the big bluffs in your way.

Getting to the temple is the easy part. The hard part is getting inside. There’s an underwater entrance at the base of the temple on the east side. Swim through it to reach a chamber with a few traps and a locked door on the other side.

When you loot the treasure at the center of the room, the chamber will begin filling with water. It won’t reach the top, so you can safely stay in the room.

To unlock the door ahead, you need to swim down into the two side passages on either side of the door and find the three buttons at the end of each path. There are two buttons in the passage to the right, and one in the passage to the left. Once all three are pressed, the door will open.

In the passage to the right of the door, you can also find Drak Relief II . It’s in a side path opposite the furthest button.

With the door opened, head up into the temple and shoot an arrow at the button overhead to unlock the exterior door. You'll have to face off with a Drak Chieftain here, and it’ll be nice to have an escape route if you need one.

To finish the quest, take out your pickaxe and dig into the pile of Gold Coins on the south side of the room . You’ll find a gold chest beneath, and opening it finishes the quest, earning you 200 XP and the Drak Temple Roof Block .

articles.title: Colorful Lights Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Colorful Lights is a side quest in Enshrouded that’s given to you by the Carpenter. He sends you to discover how the Drak manage to create different
articles.body:
Colorful Lights is a side quest in Enshrouded that’s given to you by the Carpenter. He sends you to discover how the Drak manage to create different colored lights. This side quest walkthrough will show you how to start the quest and how to wrap it up so you can start hanging variously colored lights in your settlement.

For tips on how to have the best experience in Enshrouded, check out the following pages:

You can start Colorful Lights after you complete Enveloping Blood for the Hunter. Hearing about your encounters with the Drak, the Carpenter sends you out to discover their secret to making “Colorful Lights.” Ask him about them to begin the quest.

Completing the Colorful Lights quest is quick if you know what to look for. There’s a Drak’Dal Ruin you need to travel to that’s far to the east of the Veilwater Basin Ancient Spire . Glide as far as you can and follow along the river until you reach a path at the end. It’ll take you right up to the ruin you need to search.

Before you reach the ruin, go ahead and drink your Drak Soulward Flask . There are several Draks guarding the location, and the extra damage buff will help you bring them all down. Focus on the Drak Hunters first (the ones with the Chakrams); there are enough here to stun-lock you if you aren’t careful.

With the surface cleared, head down into the underground ruin via a hole in the ground near the center of the landmark. You’ll encounter several more Drak underground, including a couple Drak Priests. Prioritize them here, as their magical attacks can be devastating without very high Magical Resistance.

Your Drak Soulward Flask should still be in effect by the time you clear the room. Along with the damage bonus it gives you, it also grants you the ability to read the Drak language. That’ll help you read the tablet on a column on the west side of the underground chamber . It mentions that Daylilies are an essential ingredient in the colorful lights.

Return to the Carpenter to share your find with him, and he’ll thank you and offer to make new lamps for your settlement. You’ll unlock two new recipes and earn 200 XP in the process.

articles.title: Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life Grand Theft Auto Research
articles.summary: A former Rockstar developer tells stories about the real-life research that went into making the Grand Theft Auto games so authentic.
articles.body:
Gregory Johnson was sitting in the back of a police car, but he wasn’t under arrest. In fact, the cops were just as nervous as him. Johnson, an experienced researcher for Rockstar, was scouting the underbelly of Los Angeles for Grand Theft Auto 5, an open-world crime game set in a fictionalized L.A. called Los Santos, which is Spanish for “The Saints.” Outside the car window, there were no saints to be found.

“We were doing a ride along in East L.A., very late at night,” Johnson told IGN in a recent interview. “It's still an active gang neighborhood where stuff is going down, so I'm knowing all the signs and seeing a lot of it, and I was super nervous about it. I was like, ‘We're probably okay, but what if we're not?’”

As the car pulled a corner, a whistle cried out from a nearby rooftop. Another series of whistles quickly followed, fading as they moved along a human daisy chain — an alarm system from a series of rooftop sentries to warn other gang members cops were on the prowl. With that, a couple of bikes shot down alleyways, pedalling fast to catch up before pulling up either side of the car to escort it on its patrol through the neighbourhood. The riders stared into the windows through masks.

“The Mexican gangs of Los Angeles are known to be very organized,” Johnson explained. “And I quickly got to the point where I was like, I know we've got police with us. I know they're armed. The logic of the moment holds that nobody wants this to turn into any situation. They don't want to generally initiate violence with the police. We don't want violence. We're just here to get a feel for the place and maybe poke our long lenses out of the windows and shoot some pictures.

“So we just got through it and ran our routes, and got everybody back to the hotel safely, but once I saw the neighborhood activate… I mean, it's amazing to see if you're going to try and duplicate it with the gameplay, right? But when you're actually in it, you're like, ‘This could go bad.’”

Even that feeling is important — the dread, the worry that things could boil over at any moment — when trying to capture the essence of a city, from its decadent hilltop houses in the Hollywood Hills to its low-income neighbourhoods over the Los Angeles River. Mood is a hard thing to capture unless you’ve felt the electricity in the air yourself as fight or flight kicks in and the hairs on the back of your neck stand to attention.

“I had to keep everybody cool in the group,” Johnson, a Floridian who lived most of his life in New York, remembered. “We've got a bunch of guys from Scotland and England, Ireland. Never seen anything like it. They're like, ‘Is everything okay, Greg?’ ‘Yeah, everything's fine.’ Completely lying. ‘Everything's fine, guys.’ It was somewhere between location scouting and espionage.”

Johnson himself knew the streets fairly well already, but he was partly recruited not just because of what he knew, but because of who he knew. Having worked on hip-hop’s Vibe Magazine for 16 years, as well as other prestigious music mags like Source, he was already embedded in the culture. He knew the people in the music industry Rockstar was working with, and helped make introductions where he could. He had his finger pushed hard into the pulse of an ever-shifting culture.

“Dan Houser had a vision for a professional research team that could easily deliver academic information,” Johnson explained. “Basically an internal form of reporting, cultural research. The role grew right as we established the department, but he had tried to get together various versions of it, and when he hired me and a couple other people around that time, I had an academic background as well as a background in hip hop journalism, and I knew the culture inside and out. We would go through tons of pop culture and various applicable subcultures.

“Rockstar has represented Jamaican yardies extremely well. The mafia culture in GTA, the Yakuza culture in GTA — all of these different subcultures and themes were really rich targets for deep dives. The better the graphics got, the better the gameplay got, the better the voiceovers got — the ambient stuff, the missions — the more background information was required to distill it into these memorable, immersive gameplay experiences. We did real life research, and these broad surveys of popular culture and the popular imagination, depending on the setting of the game, the timing of the game, and the artistic and creative direction.”

In his job as a researcher, Johnson brought a boots-on-the-ground style of journalism to the research trips, embedding himself in various cultures, from gangs to underground street racing meets. He was a voyeur, one of Rockstar’s documentarians, turning moves on the street into weekly reports for the internal blog, keeping plugged into whatever city the company was making a fictional recreation of, and distilling all of that into stories the writers could use as jumping off points. Some don’t make it into the games, but others showed up as radio advertisements, pretend TV shows, full character arcs, random encounters, ambient NPC chatter, and more. They found interesting characters and used parts of their personalities and personal stories to ground GTA’s fictional players in some form of truth.

At one point, a smuggler came across Rockstar’s radar. This was a guy who knew the late drug lord Pablo Escobar personally and was a major player in the Cocaine Cowboys era, the Scarface days, when the Medellin Cartel trafficked white powder into Miami through the ‘70s and ‘80s. According to Johnson, some of the interviews with the smuggler likely informed the Cayo Perico heist in GTA Online.

“This was one of the guys that helped the Colombians figure out their underwater submersible system, where they were, with submarines of various quality, able to bring stuff from the Colombian coast into the U.S.,” Johnson said. “That later changed. The Colombian cartels ended up cutting a deal with the Mexican cartels. But this guy was from the era when they were still getting it into the United States directly.”

The drug runner told Rockstar stories about having to pay tribute to Pablo Escobar, and the time he got kidnapped by another cartel member and held in a dingy room god-knows-where, wondering if he would be killed. His stories gave the research team a peek behind the curtain of organized crime arguably at its height. But even talking to him — despite strict NDAs protecting identities — came with its own concerns.

“Just hanging out with this guy and his sidekick in Miami, it occurred to me that revenge could visit him at any moment,” Johnson said with a nervous laugh. “And they're not going to distinguish.”

Some of the most intense encounters weren’t one-off meetings — they were in the studio where Rockstar recorded its motion capture and voice lines. Radio DJ turned writer Lazlow, Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser, and director of production Rod Edge were exposed to these the most as they ensured words on the script survived the transition to audio files.

“DJ Poo and Estevan Oriol and Mister Cartoon were bringing real gangsters,” Johnson explained. “Some of these guys are famous for bringing these guys in for bit parts and minor roles in some of the L.A. street films. It's like the Sopranos where Tony Sirico is a former Gambino associate, and he ended up getting a recurring role as Paulie Walnuts. Or The Wire, which was another television program that was a huge influence on me and Rockstar, to varying degrees. The Wire was known for bringing people out of the Baltimore streets and giving them roles on the show — ‘Snoop’ Pearson, Nathan Barksdale, and a few other legit Baltimore gangsters.

“So we would do a lot of that stuff. Some of these guys are like Salvadorian gangsters with a face full of tattoos, and you're like, ‘Say this line again with more enthusiasm.’ Or they'll tell you, ‘Check this out, bro. We wouldn't say that like that. We say this like this.’ So even though we would try to do a ton of research and make the scripts as authentic as possible, somebody that's lived that life is going to have the most current, up to date jargon and slang and lingo. A lot of them were just super excited to have their horizons opened, and get an opportunity to do voiceover work.”

It wasn’t all fear, either. When Johnson worked on GTA 6 , the research team took a helicopter from Miami to Key West, flying low over the barrier islands with a long lens — Johnson never imagined he’d see the city and its surrounding areas like this. Sometimes up-close, sometimes a bird’s-eye view, always documenting and capturing the vibe to bottle up and digitize, top to bottom, micro and macro — this authenticity and obsessive attention to detail is what makes Rockstar open-worlds feel so alive.

“There was a ton of stuff,” Johnson said. “I would visit the prisons. They were nervous but hilarious. It was our job to give the developers the exposure they needed to any one of these areas of the game, whether it was the underworld stuff or street racers, or whatever. Anything we could do to make the experience more immersive and authentic, like sitting down with FBI agents or gangsters or working as location scouts. Basically we had a broad mandate, and I think we did a pretty good job of it.”

The extreme lengths Rockstar developers go to in the aim of creating authentic worldsare partly why there’s such a buzz behind GTA 6, which has already generated $1 billion in preorder sales . No one does it like Rockstar, and the audience knows this.

Rockstar recently spoke about its GTA 6 research trips (some of which Johnson attended — he left the company halfway through development). It’s where every game starts, but the process continues throughout development to keep the writers and designers keyed into the culture of the place they’re basing the game world on. The company even built out an entire studio just to write dialogue for pedestrian NPCs, such is its commitment to the craft of making a living simulation.

GTA 6 launches on November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.

articles.title: Johnny Depp Comeback Movie Ebenezer Scares Up a Startling Box Office Opening
articles.summary: Johnny Depp-infused A Christmas Carol adaptation Ebenezer is off to a strong start, and has already earned back its production budget.
articles.body:
Johnny Depp-infused A Christmas Carol adaptation Ebenezer is off to a strong start, and has already earned back its production budget.

Ebenezer earned $19 million domestically over its first weekend, and conjured up a $42 million worldwide opening gross. According to Entertainment Weekly , Ebenezer had a $38 million production budget, though that does not include the film's additional marketing and promotional costs.

While it's certainly a promising start — and seemingly a vote of confidence in Depp after his recent Hollywood hiatus — it remains to be seen how well the movie will perform over time. Ebenezer has received a decidedly mixed response from critics, including for Depp's typically eccentric take on the Dickensian antihero.

Could this damp down the film's performance over time? Perhaps. And next weekend will see the arrival of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which looks set to become a blockbuster. Though as Christmas itself gets ever closer, it's easy to see audiences still turning up to Ebenezer as the season gets more festive.

Next up for the star is Day Drinker, a supernatural revenge film coming next year with Madelyn Cline and Penélope Cruz. And then there are the long-discussed potential plans for Depp to return in a fresh Pirates of the Caribbean entry . Whether that actually happens or not, however, remains to be seen.

Is Depp's big return worth your valuable time this holiday season? IGN's Ebenezer review returned a 6/10 score, and described it thus:

"Ti West’s Ebenezer does a respectable enough job taking a more horror-forward approach to A Christmas Carol, but the Johnny Depp performance at the heart of the film pulls more focus than is necessary, even for a story about a man who goes around yelling 'bah, humbug' at children and adults alike."

Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

articles.title: Anthony Mackie Insists He Didn't Spoil Avengers: Doomsday by Revealing an Unannounced Character
articles.summary: Marvel star Anthony Mackie has insisted he did not drop a big Avengers: Doomsday spoiler last week, when he appeared to reveal an unannounced character.
articles.body:
Marvel star Anthony Mackie has insisted he did not drop a big Avengers: Doomsday spoiler last week, when he appeared to reveal an unannounced character.

In an interview with Entertainment Tonight , Mackie said he had enjoyed filming Marvel's upcoming mega blockbuster as it had given him a chance to "just catch up with everybody." Specifically, Mackie mentioned singled out his downtime with Shang-Chi star Simu Liu and VisionQuest actor Paul Bettany as particular highlights.

As Marvel fans will know, Bettany's character Vision is yet to be confirmed as appearing in Doomsday — something that many pointed out in response to Mackie's statement. So, in other words, why was Bettany around to hang out with?

The Most Surprising Avengers and Marvel Characters Not Announced for Doomsday

Now, however, Mackie has appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon to set the record straight — and insist that Avengers' production simply gave him the chance to visit Bettany on the separate VisionQuest production that was going on next door.

"Paul Bettany is my man, my homie, we hang out all the time," Mackie began. "He was shooting VisionQuest next door to where we were shooting Avengers. So, me being me, I steal a golf cart and pull up. I'm a pull-upper.

"So I didn't say he was in Doomsday, I said he was next door shooting his show. Just like Tom Holland was next door shooting Spider-Man.

"He was next door!" Mackie concluded. "He wasn't in the movie... I guess?"

Somewhat ironically, Mackie's claim is backed up by an actual Marvel set leak from last year , where an Instagram user somehow managed to get into the production area at the U.K.'s Leavesdon studios and film what they thought was a Avengers: Doomsday set. Except it wasn't — it was the Madripoor set that was actually used in VisionQuest, as the two productions really did share studio space side-by-side.

Could Vision still appear in Doomsday? Sure. While likely not a major focus of the film, it's easy to imagine the synthezoid dad and his two sons turning up somewhere, fresh from their reunion in VisionQuest. That series' shock post-credits scene even pointed to the Maximoff family being set on a path to Doctor Doom, as the Latverian ruler appeared to rouse Wanda from her grave under Mount Wundagore.

articles.title: ¿Qué tienen en común Laporte, Pedri, Dani Olmo y Los Buyer? La respuesta está en un juego de hace 25 años
articles.standfirst: Los jugadores de la selección española se echaron una partida a Los Hombres Lobos de Castronegro y lo recordamos con motivo de su 25 aniversario... mientras repasamos su historia.
articles.summary: Los jugadores de la selección española se echaron una partida a Los Hombres Lobos de Castronegro y lo recordamos con motivo de su 25 aniversario... mientras repasamos su historia.
articles.body: Hace 25 años, Dimitry Davidoff, Philippe des Pallières y Hervé Marly diseñaron el que hoy día dice ser uno de los mejores juegos de mesa —y uno de los más queridos y laureados— de la historia: Los hombres lobo de Castronegro. Lo que quizá muchos no saben es que este juego debe su origen, en cierta manera, a un estudio psicológico. El registro más antiguo que se tiene de este data de 1986, año en el que Dimitry Davidoff quiso estudiar una dinámica muy concreta: información vs. desinformación. El por aquel entonces estudiante de psicología en la Universidad Estatal de Moscú diseñó un juego llamado Mafia en el que un grupo de asesinos tenía que acabar con todo un pueblo antes de que este descubriese su identidad. Con el tiempo, entre los años 80 y los 90, se extendió. También llegó a España, donde se le acabó conociendo como El pueblo duerme o Asesino. Con el tiempo, aquel juego popular acabó dando forma a Los hombres lobo de Castronegro, una versión mucho más refinada que la original. Con cartas especialmente diseñadas e ilustradas para él y un conjunto de reglas sencillo de entender, pero muy completo, llegó a nuestras vidas. De eso han pasado 25 años y ha llegado tan lejos que incluso llegó a la mesa de Pedri, Dani Olmo, Laporte, Cubarsí y Víctor Muñoz junto a los hermanos Buyer, dos de los creadores de contenido más destacados del panorama nacional. A la vista queda que se lo pasaron muy bien, y tiene sentido, porque es uno de esos juegos en los que, si entras en la atmósfera, te atrapa por completo y ya no puedes escapar. Pero ¿cómo se juega? Reduciéndolo muchísimo, el juego divide a la gente en dos equipos: lobos y pueblerinos. Un narrador reparte las cartas y los jugadores las tienen que consultar en secreto. Cada uno tendrá un rol, desde Hombre Lobo hasta Aldeano, pasando por algunos especiales como la Bruja (que puede usar sus pociones para salvar o asesinar a otros jugadores), Cupido (que puede enamorar a dos personas que morirán si uno de los dos cae) o el Cazador (que puede pegarle un tiro a alguien si muere por la noche). Cada noche, el narrador les pide a los jugadores que cierren los ojos al decir "el pueblo duerme" y va despertando a distintos personajes por turno para que, en silencio, hagan sus acciones. Por ejemplo, les pedirá a los lobos que señalen a su víctima. Cuando el pueblo despierte, tendrán que votar por los sospechosos e intentar encontrar a los lobos. Es como Among Us, pero en formato de mesa y con un abanico de posibilidades mucho más amplio. El caso es que Los hombres lobo de Castronegro está celebrando su 25.º aniversario. Así es. Han pasado 25 años desde su lanzamiento y sigue estando tan vigente como el primer día. Puede que incluso más, ya que hablamos de un juego de mesa que tiene muchas opciones diferentes. Yo, por ejemplo, llevo jugando más de 15 años a él y desde hace unos cuantos tengo Los Hombres Lobo de Castronegro: El Pacto, una versión en formato caja que tiene más de 30 personajes diferentes, edificios, poderes... Es una versión para jugar en masa con hasta 18 personas. Luego está la nueva edición Los Hombres Lobo de Castronegro Edición 25 años, una versión que conmemora toda su historia y agrega 4 nuevos personajes. Tienes La Asamblea del Mal, una versión inspirada en los Villanos de Disney, la edición clásica con sus diferentes expansiones... Vaya, que hay donde elegir, así que, si te ha llamado la atención, no te preocupes, porque opciones hay para rato.

articles.title: GTA 6 Gets Another Day One Patch, and It's 1GB Bigger on Xbox

GTA 6 is finally almost here. With the November 19 launch date just around the corner, Rockstar is preparing the game for its public showing.

articles.title: Cool New Cyberpunk 2077 Mod Adds 3D Rain Effects That Catch the Light and Blow in the Wind
articles.summary: A new Cyberpunk 2077 mod understands that, and changes the game’s 2D rain effects into a proper 3D weather simulation. It’s called Torrent, and comes from a Modder called CyanideX.
articles.body:
Rain used to be one of the key things you’d look at when the next generation of consoles landed to see how far video game graphics have come. I still remember being blown away by the opening of Metal Gear Solid 2 and its rain-battered ship at sea — there’s just something about the tap, tap, tap of sky water that pulls you into a world.

A new Cyberpunk 2077 mod understands that, and changes the game’s 2D rain effects into a proper 3D weather simulation. It’s called Torrent, and comes from a Modder called CyanideX.

“Night City's rain is drawn as flat cards of streaks, so it reads as a sheet hung in front of the camera more than rain falling around you,” the mod description said. “Torrent replaces it with rain made of real drops, falling through the world in depth, lit by the city's lights and stopped by roofs, bridges and your own car.

“Storms get wind-blown mist, and lightning with thunder rolling in after it. It draws its rain in the game's own rain pass and hides the game's rain only where Torrent's drew, so if anything ever goes wrong you get the game's rain back instead of none. Nothing is saved to your game, so you can install or remove it whenever you like.”

Each of the 3D rain drops in the mod has varying sizes and speed, and they’re impacted by weather and catch the light from passing vehicles. Droplets that hit surfaces explode into a fine mist.

Vehicles also interact with rain and puddles, with spray kicking up from car tyres as they move through the rainy Night City streets. A fine mist kicks up behind you as you drive.

As well as normal rain, the mod also includes variations so there’s light showers and heavy downpour, as well as toxic rain. According to the mod page, it’s compatible with lots of other weather effect mods so it should hopefully slot in and work with whatever you’re currently running.

Storms are also included as part of the package, complete with lightning bolts and strobing clouds that light up your surroundings like a camera flash. The mod is set up to keep the effects as random as possible, so you’re never seeing the exact same weather pattern play out.

Players who are sensitive to flashing lights can tone down the strobing effects in the options, replacing them with a softer glow. Or you can turn them off completely. Accessibility options in mods, what a time to be alive. You can check the mod out over at Nexus Mods (thanks, DSO Gaming ).

articles.title: UK Politician Downplays Fears Around GTA 6 Content for Kids, Says She's More Concerned About the Amount of Time They'll Likely Play It
articles.summary: Prominent U.K. politician Kemi Badenoch has downplayed parents' fears over the violent content found in GTA 6, and said she's more concerned by how long many kids will likely spend in their bedrooms playing it.
articles.body:
Prominent U.K. politician Kemi Badenoch has downplayed parents' fears over the violent content found in GTA 6, and said that she's more concerned by how long many kids will likely spend in their bedrooms playing it.

It's perhaps a surprising stance from Badenoch as leader of the right-leaning Conservative party, though one that she said was informed by her own experiences with video games while younger.

"I would be more worried about the amount of time people were spending on a game than the game specifically," Badenoch said during a news conference today broadcast via Sky News . "I remember in my childhood playing Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter — I didn't hit anybody after playing those games.

"I haven't played Grand Theft Auto, I know people are worried about the game content," Badenoch continued. "At the same time, I'd be more worried about a kid who played it all day, who was in their bedroom all day, than one who spends half an hour on it and then went outside to do something else."

The subject of GTA 6 arose as the Tory leader laid out more of her party's education policy, which calls for a cut in the amount of time children spend in front of screens while at school. Indeed, Badenoch announced that funds would be diverted from the U.K. government's school laptop budget to buy millions of physical textbooks instead.

GTA 6 is now just days away from launch and we have a pretty good idea of the adult content that will be on offer in Rockstar's blockbuster. Age ratings from around the world describe GTA 6 as living up to its usual expectations, with the ESRB in particular warning that the game features "blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, strong sexual content and use of drugs and alcohol."

While GTA 6 is of course rated for adults only, it's fair to say that it's likely that millions of under 18s will end up playing it anyway, if indeed they haven't already begun forging their school sick notes in order to do so. Rather than pretend no kids will play it, Badenoch is perhaps simply trying to draw something of a compromise. Of course some younger fans will likely play GTA 6 — but no one should be mainlining it 24/7 in their bedroom, full stop.

GTA 6 launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. For more, you can check out IGN's preview from earlier this year. You can also check out the recent leak that spilled the full track list for the game's official album , and why we're excited to jump into Vice City, even if it's at 30fps .

articles.title: Robert Pattinson Cast as James Bond in Next 007 Movie
articles.summary: After years of rumors and speculation, Twilight and The Batman star Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as James Bond in Denis Villeneuve's 007 movie.
articles.body:
After years of rumors and speculation, Twilight and The Batman star Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as James Bond in Denis Villeneuve's 007 movie .

Official 007 social media accounts confirmed the news today. Additional details about Pattinson's Bond debut remain unclear, but the announcement post did include a first look, which you can see below.

"James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement . "I'm deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team."

Identity Confirmed — James Bond (@007) November 16, 2026

Villeneuve also released a statement on choosing Pattinson to play 007:

"Before anything else, I want to express my deep gratitude to the remarkable actors who joined us on this journey. We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007. I am overjoyed to welcome Robert Pattinson as our new James Bond. He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new. I cannot wait to begin."

The Hollywood Reporter shared additional details about Pattinson's casting and how the news was kept under lock and key in a new report. Contenders are said to have been judged on stunts, camera presence, and dialogue while testing for the role.

As the competition for Bond stayed behind closed doors, Amazon reportedly became even more secretive after actually making its decision. In fact, THR reported that, while everyone online patiently awaited updates, it wasn't until yesterday morning that Villeneuve contacted Pattinson to inform him that he had landed the part. Producer Amy Pascal reportedly called the runner-ups.

Pattinson has evolved into a Hollywood name that needs no introduction, but we'll break it down anyway. He first truly made a name for himself as sparkling vampire Edward Cullen in the Twilight Saga in the 2000s and early 2010s. Keeping from being held within the romance adaptation box, he eventually started showing up films like The Lighthouse and Good Time. After showing up in Christopher Nolan's Tenet 2020, he went on to appear in one of the biggest comic book movie roles in history as the lead of The Batman in 2022.

Pattinson also has projects like Mickey 17 and Die My Love under his belt. This year alone, he's starred in Nolan's The Odyssey, The Drama, Primetime, and next month, he'll show up in Villeneuve's Dune: Part 3 as Scytale. Now, while shooting The Batman Part 2, he's casually picked up 007.

Even those who have kept up with all of the latest updates on Amazon MGM's hunt for Bond recognize Pattinson's casting arrives as a last-minute twist. Although the Dune and Arrival director was confirmed to helm the next iteration of film's legendary British secret agent in mid-2025, questions about who would adopt the 007 mantle have swirled since Daniel Craig stepped away from the part following the release of No Time to Die in 2021.

As unsubstantiated internet rumors throwing out names like Tom Holland and Idris Elba subsided, more concrete background details on the hunt eventually emerged. Callum Turner (One Night Only) and Jacob Elordi (Euphoria) were two faces talked about earlier on, with Slow Horses star Jack Lowden then entering the conversation courtesy of Gary Oldman shortly after. Finally, just last month, Amazon reportedly narrowed its search to a small collection of actors , including Lowden, Turner, and Josh O'Connor (Challengers). Nicholas Hoult (Mad Max: Fury Road) is also believed to have tested for the role (apparently One Direction singer and Dunkirk actor Harry Styles made a few calls, too).

Early in the process, Amazon was reportedly said to be looking for a "fresh face" to take over as James Bond . Then, out of the darkness came Pattinson .

When production for The Batman Part 2 was hit with an unexpected and temporary break , the actor reportedly took the window as an opportunity to test for 007. It was all the time he needed, and he apparently made such an impression that his deal offered higher pay for fewer films .

With the part of the eighth James Bond now firmly on his already extensive resume, what comes next for Pattinson is anyone's guess. Seeing one star lead two major franchises on the level of something like 007 and Batman isn't completely unheard of, but it's not exactly common either. The expectation thus far as been that Pattinson would likely return for a third Batman movie down the line, but with the DC universe currently facing its own major shakeup, there's no telling how that might affect his time as the Caped Crusader.

Meanwhile, Pattinson's newfound Bond obligations are also unclear. Puck reported just last week that the actor's contract included a committment to three 007 movies. It's too soon to say if those details will pan out, but we can at least finally say now that Pattinson is your new James Bond .

James Bond: No Time To Die Character Posters

Villeneuve's 007 currently has no release date, but with a lead nailed down, we hopefully won't have to wait too much longer for Amazon to share updates. Peaky Blinders' Steven Knight is writing the script. If anything is certain, it's that the internet will have a lot to say about all of this. You can read about what everyone thought about previous James Bond castings here .

articles.title: Xbox Project Helix Isn't a PC After All
articles.summary: Ever since Microsoft first teased its next-generation console/PC hybrid last year, there's been a lot of speculation on what Project Helix even is. And while that speculation is going to continue until Microsoft actually reveals the next-gen Xbox, the company has shed a bit more light on what we can expect.
articles.body:
Ever since Microsoft first teased its next-generation console/PC hybrid last year, there's been a lot of speculation on what Project Helix even is. And while that speculation is going to continue until Microsoft actually reveals the next-gen Xbox, the company has shed a bit more light on what we can expect.

As part of its 25th anniversary celebration, Microsoft put out a special "Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine" that covered everything from the new Xbox Nano controller to World of Warcraft Forever . But the issue also had a huge story on "The Soul of Project Helix" where Xbox VP of Next Generation (that's a real job title) Jason Ronald gave a bit more detail on what Helix actually is.

Back when Sarah Bond revealed the partnership behind the "next generation hardware," she emphasized that Xbox was working with the Windows team to make the desktop OS "the number one platform for gaming." Ever since then, the assumption was that Helix would be something akin to a gaming PC . But in the Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine, Ronald states clearly that "Helix is designed to be a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC. It is not a PC that can also play console games."

XBOX Series X25 Limited Edition Console Images

The goal, instead, is "making it easy, intuitive and instant to access my games." But while the focus is on creating a console, Ronald still says "if you're a hardcore gamer or a power user who wants to have that deeper level of customizability across settings and performance options, you can absolutely go do it."

It's impossible to tell exactly what Ronald is describing, here, though. Because Project Helix will be able to run PC games, there is a certain amount of freedom that it has to give users, otherwise Microsoft could unintentionally lock players out from parts of their game library, especially on some of the lesser-known PC game platforms. It doesn't sound like Microsoft wants to stop anyone from playing any of their games. Instead, Ronald said he wants to "remove the arbitrary constraints between console and PC games."

In reality, the Project Helix operating system is probably going to be some kind of branch off of Windows 11, and is going to take some of the DNA from the ROG Xbox Ally X. As Ronald puts it, "The ROG Xbox Ally was really an opportunity for us to learn alongside our player base with a lot of these concepts and the ideas that we had: being able to play libraries from across multiple different storefronts, understanding how PC games and console games can show up together in a unified library."

I have used the Xbox Ally X a ton over the last year, and while a lot of the bones of a console-like experience are there, I'm not sure it'll ever fully translate to the kind of polish you see on the Xbox Series X homepage. And Ronald is aware of that, too.

"The feedback that we've gotten from players has fundamentally informed and altered our plans of how it actually shows up in a future console," Ronald said. "Players shared where we met the mark and areas we needed to improve or approach differently. So absolutely, we view the Ally as a precursor to what we're doing with Helix – but it's informed by a lot of the design concepts we have for Helix."

The biggest concern for the next generation of consoles isn't really which operating system they're running on, or whether you can run Excel – the question is the pricing, and it's not looking pretty. While Ronald does try to talk around the prices, it still doesn't sound like Project Helix is going to be especially affordable.

Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 – Hands-On Photos

"It's definitely a challenging time," he continued, "but as a system and platform designer it's also one of the most exciting times, because we have to invent entirely new technology to continue to advance the state-of-the-art while also continuing to make things accessible and affordable." I guess we'll see just how "accessible and affordable" the console is when it actually gets unveiled – however long that's going to take.

It also seems like Microsoft is using the RAM crisis to justify the need for neural rendering in Project Helix, as well. When talking about price, Ronald says, "This is a big reason why we're really focused on advancements like neural rendering, because it's an entirely new way to generate a frame without requiring more computational horsepower, additional memory, and things like that."

For the uninitiated, Nvidia's DLSS 5 is a major example of neural rendering tech that's actually made it to mainstream games like NBA 2K27 and Hogwarts Legacy. The idea is to improve visual quality in games by using AI to enhance images within the rendering pipeline. And it sure sounds like that tech is coming to the next-generation Xbox in one way or another.

My hope is that they keep it optional. No matter how you feel about DLSS 5, it does have a massive impact on performance while altering the way a game looks. Luckily, in the official implementations so far, it's been a relatively minor change, but there are definitely some modders who have pushed the technology to comical levels.

With the way that graphics tech is moving lately, there's no telling what Project Helix will be capable of until it's actually in our hands. I hope that Microsoft does go for an operating system that feels at home on a TV. I was worried that it would just lean on the Xbox full screen experience, and it just isn't there yet. At least it sounds like no matter how the OS feels to navigate with a controller, it's still focused on giving people finer controls over how the system runs. And if Microsoft plans to lean on tech like neural rendering and frame generation, that's going to be more important than ever.

Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. She's been covering gaming hardware for more than a decade for IGN, TechRadar, Gizmodo, PC Gamer and more. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

articles.title: Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection Back in Stock at Amazon, But There's a Catch
articles.summary: Pokémon TCG fans can finally score the elusive 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection at Amazon before bots and scalpers claim the restock. But is it the best deal going right now?

articles.title: Fox News Talked About GTA 6, and It Went as Well as You'd Expect
articles.summary: Fox & Friends discusses GTA 6 ahead of launch, saying it won't be a good thing for "our culture and society."
articles.body:
Fox News and video games — I am sure the very mention of these two things together is enough to send a chill down your spine if you are of a certain age. Back in the '00s, Fox was at the forefront of the campaign against games, whether they were deemed too violent or, in Mass Effect's case, too raunchy .

Turns out, all of these years later, not much has changed. Grand Theft Auto 6 came up on Fox & Friends over the weekend as we get into launch week, and we got the classics: misinformation and moral panics.

As one of the hosts was reading off some of GTA 6's gameplay, such as talking to NPCs and petting dogs — stuff that isn't exactly unique to the game — another host, Rachel Campos-Duffy, interjected, saying she had to "push back" against it.

"I really am gonna say I'm not thinking this is a good thing for our culture and society," Campos-Duffy noted. "But let's see what you think after it comes out."

The other host then continued to list the features in GTA 6, pointing out that you can play as both Jason and Lucia. Campos-Duffy piped up again when Lucia is namedropped, and says, "She's a hooker."

It was then clarified that Lucia is a "partner in crime" to Jason, but that you could maybe play her to go "straight," moving away from the life.

For obvious reasons, the claim that Lucia is a sex worker has the most attention here. It would, of course, not be a problem if that is part of her backstory, but there's been no indication of that, so it's unclear what made Campos-Duffy jump to that conclusion. Given that this is Fox News, it is also fair to assume that they're not coming at this from a feminist angle, more so fearful about the prospect of sex being in this game. Which it almost definitely will be, based on what we know so far.

In any case, GTA 6 drops this Thursday. We will be able to see for ourselves if this is really as damaging to culture and society as Fox News fears.

Rhiannon (she/her) is a freelance journalist who has been in the industry since 2019. She won MCV's Women in Games award in 2025 and adores RPGs. You can follow her on Bluesky at @rhithewitch.

articles.title: Xbox Offers Doctor’s Note for Undefined Gaming Session Definitely Not Linked to GTA 6
articles.summary: Xbox has kicked off its marketing for the game it’s not allowed to mention in its marketing. Like the weird alligator-shaped Xbox recently announced, Microsoft is doing its best to get Xbox players excited about GTA 6 without saying the game’s name.
articles.body:
Xbox has kicked off its marketing for the game it’s not allowed to mention in its marketing. Like the weird alligator-shaped Xbox recently announced , Microsoft is doing its best to get Xbox players excited about GTA 6 without saying the game’s name.

“Are you suffering from Vitamin G deficiency?” the new marketing blast asked. “Dr. XBOX has you covered.” I don’t know much about supplements, but there’s a real lack of vitamin G, T, and A over there.

For some reason, Dr. Xbox is DJ Khalid, and he wants to get you ready for “the biggest week in gaming.” What makes it the biggest week? No one knows.

In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023

The website lets you put your name in and get a personalized doctor’s note to play games this week on your Xbox. Obviously DJ Khalid isn’t a medical professional, and there’s no gamer vitamin, so it probably won’t work on your boss, unfortunately.

“As their physician, mentor, and professional motivator, I am prescribing the patient take some time off to enjoy the biggest week in gaming,” the letter read after I put my details in. “I advise they avoid all meetings, highly stressful jobs, and unnecessary negativity.

“Symptoms may include: twitchy thumbs, controller cramps or release-date restlessness.”

There isn’t a single mention of what makes this the biggest week in gaming. That’s likely because Sony has an exclusive marketing deal with Rockstar to promote the game coming to PlayStation.

This has led to some pretty embarrassing misses on Xbox’s part. The first version of the GTA 6 TV spot failed to mention the game coming to Xbox consoles at all.

Microsoft did manage to muscle in a little more recently, with the announcement that you can play GTA 6 on the cloud . This means even people who only own an Xbox One can play GTA 6 if they stream it, which gets them access to the game at Xbox Series S graphics settings.

We still don’t know what Xbox Series S graphics settings means, however. Rockstar has said GTA 6 will run at 30fps on all platforms , and PS5 Pro gets some ray tracing upgrades, but there’s no word on what kind of compromises the studio had to make to have the game run on the Xbox Series S. We need a doctor on the case.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

articles.title: Avengers: Secret Wars Will Be a Different Genre to Doomsday and Unlike Anything Else You've Ever Seen, Marvel Says
articles.summary: Excited for Avengers: Doomsday? Well, Marvel has already begun teasing sequel Avengers: Secret Wars, which sounds like it will be completely different.
articles.body:
Excited for Avengers: Doomsday ? Well, Marvel has already begun teasing its sequel Avengers: Secret Wars, which sounds like it will be completely different.

While fans have a fair idea of what to expect from next month's Avengers blockbuster, Secret Wars is currently living up to its name as something of a mystery. By now, many Marvel followers expect to see Earth's mightiest heroes coming together to fight Doctor Doom... only for everything to end on an Infinity War-style cliffhanger, leading into next year's conclusion.

But how will Secret Wars follow Doomsday, live up to the expectation of an Endgame-level finale, and stand apart from everything before it? Well, by being a completely different genre and unlike anything audiences have seen before, Marvel has now said.

Avengers: Doomsday Trailer: First Look at Doctor Doom

Speaking to Empire , Marvel boss Kevin Feige teased that Secret Wars would be "a whole other genre of story" to this year's team-up movie. Joe Russo, co-director of both films, added that it would feature "a really unique world." Hmm — some kind of battle world , perhaps?

"The only reason to get out of bed every day is to take risks and surprise people and try things that have never been tried before," Russo added. "I think Secret Wars is one of those movies where I hope people will walk out of it and go, ‘I’ve never seen anything like that in my life!'"

While still a year away, it's fun to speculate exactly what Secret Wars will feature, as the finale to Marvel's divisive Multiverse Saga and, apparently, something of a soft reset for the MCU in general. Of course, Marvel comics fans will have their own theories on what will likely happen, though the MCU obviously puts its own twists on even the most famous comic book runs. Where will the dust settle after all is said and done? We'll have to wait until December 2027 for that, though thankfully Avengers: Doomsday will be along first in just over a month.

Avengers: Doomsday is set to premiere December 18, 2026, meaning we're only weeks away from its release date. Last week, we learned that Deadpool and Wolverine stars Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds have writing credits on the movie . Feige also debunked one of the biggest theories regarding potential connections between Downey's Tony Stark and Doctor Doom .

articles.body:
When you’ve got an open world as big and dense as Grand Theft Auto, you’ve got to fill it with something . From hearts and minds to signs and shrines, the inside jokes and little secrets are Rockstar’s calling card, tucked into every corner of the map; these are some of the best easter eggs in GTA games.
